The '''Imperial Biological Welfare Division''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], serving as a cover-up for the [[Imperial Biological Weapons Division]]. The Division claimed to be working to ensure that [[Species/Legends|species]] weren't decimated by diseases.
